# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `hq` MCP server pointing at HQ's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://hq-mcp.getindigo.ai/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and HQ sign-in — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: HQ's official app icon from hqforwork.com.
